intro: After displaying some scintillating form prior to the international break, Bournemouth will be hoping to pick up where they left off when they host a Nottingham Forest side who had a great result of their own before the pause.
h2h: Bournemouth are unbeaten in all eight Premier League H2Hs (W4, D4) and haven’t been beaten at home by Forest in any competition since 2014/15 (W4, D2).
datos: Bournemouth have conceded ten of their 14 league goals this season after half-time.
Bournemouth have led a league-high seven games at the break this season (HT: D2, L1).
Forest have conceded nine of their 13 league goals this season after half-time.
Six of Forest’s last seven away league games saw both teams score.
Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Bournemouth's Marcus Tavernier has won a career-high eight H2Hs against Forest and has either scored or assisted in the last three Premier League meetings. Liam Delap netted a brace in Forest’s win against City and has now netted four of his last five club goals after half-time, while his sole career league goal against Bournemouth also came in the second half.

Bournemouth’s Rayan picked up a knock on international duty with Brazil but should be fit here, while Forest’s Neco Williams missed Wales’ second Nations League game and faces a race against time to be fit here.
For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.
These sides tend to be leakier after half-time, so a punt on both teams to score in the second half could be worth considering.
